principalMessage.description: On choosing Narayanleela, putting character before grades, and the school you helped us build.

message.paragraph1: Dear Parents, at Narayanleela we believe every child carries within them the seeds of extraordinary potential. Our role — yours at home, ours at school — is to nurture those seeds with care, patience and unwavering belief.
message.paragraph2: For over two decades, our campus has been a second home to thousands of children. We have watched shy first-graders blossom into confident speakers and quiet observers become tomorrow's leaders.
message.paragraph3: We do not chase rankings; we chase character. We measure success in the kindness, curiosity and courage our students carry into the world.

story.title: How we began, why we stay
story.paragraph1: Narayanleela English Medium School opened its doors in 2001 with a small group of teachers, a hand-painted board and twenty-three curious children. The promise was simple: an English-medium education rooted in Indian values, accessible to families across Arni.
story.paragraph2: Two decades on, that promise still defines us. The classrooms are larger and the syllabus is broader — but the everyday choice we make as educators has not changed. We measure success in the kindness, curiosity and courage our students carry with them.
story.paragraph3: Today over 1,500 students study with us across Pre-Primary, Primary and Secondary. Eighty teachers know each child by name. The same campus that began as a single building now spans smart classrooms, science and computer labs, a library, sports grounds and one of the safest school-transport fleets in the district.

q1.question: When does the admission window open?
q1.answer: Admissions for the 2026 – 27 academic year are open from January and continue until seats are filled. Pre-Primary fills the fastest, so earlier inquiries help.

q2.question: Is there an entrance test?
q2.answer: Pre-Primary and Grades 1 – 5 do not require a written test — only an informal conversation with the child. Grades 6 – 10 include a short subject-knowledge assessment to place students in the right group.

q3.question: Is school transport available?
q3.answer: Yes. GPS-tracked buses with trained drivers and female attendants cover most routes across Arni. Routes and fee details are shared at the inquiry stage.

q4.question: What is the medium of instruction?
q4.answer: English is the primary medium across all subjects except language classes. Hindi and Marathi are taught as full subjects.

q5.question: What is the typical class size?
q5.answer: Pre-Primary classes are capped at 25 students with one teacher and one assistant. Primary and Secondary sections range from 30 to 35 students per class.

q6.question: Do you offer scholarships?
q6.answer: Yes — we have a small scholarship pool for academically deserving students from families with financial need. Please ask about it during your campus visit.
